name: TC-853: Duplicate opens Create prefilled as a copy and saves nothing until asked
description: The row menu's Duplicate opens "Copy a promotion" with the type and amount of the original, the name "Copy of <name>" and an empty code; leaving without saving creates no second promotion.
descriptionHtml: The row menu's Duplicate opens "Copy a promotion" with the type and amount of the original, the name "Copy of " and an empty code; leaving without saving creates no second promotion.

testStage.description: The row menu's Duplicate opens "Copy a promotion" with the type and amount of the original, the name "Copy of <name>" and an empty code; leaving without saving creates no second promotion.

steps.name: Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('table', { name: 'Promotions' }).or(getByText('No promotions yet', { exact: true }))
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('table', { name: 'Promotions' }).or(getByText('No promotions yet', { exact: true }))

Click getByRole('table', { name: 'Promotions' }).getByRole('row').filter({ has: getByText('AUTO Duplicate ffa55dcb', { exact: true }) }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Actions for AUTO Duplicate ffa55dcb', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Copy a promotion', level: 1 })
Expect "toBeChecked" getByRole('radio', { name: /^(Selected )?Money off the order / })
Expect "toHaveValue" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Amount off', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveValue" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Promotion name', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveValue" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Code customers type', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 }).or(getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Leave without saving?' })).first()
Click getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Leave without saving?' }).getByRole('button', { name: 'Leave', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Promotions', exact: true, level: 1 })
